a0: Grade strongly at singular or re-entrant corners and other stress concentrations: very small local sizes there, coarse elsewhere.
a1: Economy: reach the accuracy target with as few DOFs as possible; prefer the coarsest mesh that still beats the automesher.
a2: Refine every geometric feature (holes, fillets, corners, thin sections) moderately rather than any single one strongly.
a3: Refine along the loaded and supported boundaries, where the boundary conditions drive the stress gradients.
